document: DoH Circular 2026/10: Mandatory On-boarding of Minimum Required Dataset with Malaffi
text: Subject:  Mandatory On-boarding - Minimum Required Dataset with Malaffi Platform for All Healthcare Facilities in Abu Dhabi We extend our greetings and best wishes for your continued success. In alignment with DoH’s Policy on the Abu Dhabi Health Information Exchange, all are required to comply with the data reporting requirements to Malaffi platform. In addition, all are required to ensure that the minimum datasets (attached) are connected and successfully transmitting data to the Malaffi platform within six (6) months from the date of this circular. Please reach out to Abu Dhabi Health Data Services team to confirm which data sets are applicable for your facility type. Each facility must submit an implementation plan to Malaffi Onboarding team within 1 month of this circular date, via email: (onboarding@malaffi.ae) Failure to comply with the above (submission of plan within one month and on-boarding within six months) will render the facility non-compliant with DoH policy and may result in denial/restriction of license renewal. Furthermore, DoH will monitor data submission compliance for all required datasets and necessary action will be taken in case of non-compliance. Should you require any clarification or assistance with your implementation plan or on-boarding process, please contact the ADHDS/Malaffi Team via email: (onboarding@malaffi.ae) or contact the DoH HIE Office via email:
